name: carrotpilot HUD: follow distance, speed limit, lead
author: CommaView (example pack)
description: carrotpilot's own comma 3X onroad additions that CommaView doesn't export: the follow-distance line across the path with its distance beside it, the speed limit and speed camera box (LIMIT / CAM, blinking red and yellow for a camera) from carrotMan, and the radar distance box at the lead car. carrotpilot (ajouatom/openpilot) only.
